inputs.original_text: This looks less like a public-safety explanation and more like a coordinated effort to turn one arrest into cover for expanding federal power. DHS is setting up a “sanctuary versus public safety” story that makes harsher enforcement seem inevitable, while keeping the fuller picture out of view. The timing and emphasis aren’t incidental; they’re part of how institutions manufacture consent.

DHS is framing it as “sanctuary versus public safety” to make harsher enforcement seem inevitable while keeping the fuller picture out of view. The timing and emphasis appear deliberate—part of how institutions manufacture consent.
